items.html: *In the beginning the ten were a simple self, and they were comprised of ten, but it was not recognisable in them. And the GAR, which were mercies, were able to receive the light of Ein Sof; but when it reached the seven Nekudot, they were annulled. And these are the kings that died: because they are judgment, and the light that came is mercy, they were not able to receive it; and since they did not receive the vitality, they died. Therefore it was necessary to arrange that vessels be made for the Keter, and thereby the light that comes and passes through a screen would be sweetened; and further, that these ten would be recognisable in it. And these kings are below Malchut of Atzilut, and none of them remained except Hadar, because they were male and female, and they are Tifferet and Malchut.
